About.headline: Beyond code, engineering.
About.paragraph1: I am a developer focused on building secure and high-performance solutions. I learn by doing—mastering complex concepts through real-world projects rather than isolated study.
About.paragraph2: My main focus is web & mobile development, software quality assurance (QA), and security-by-design. Holding a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science (IT Systems Security option), I combine a strong academic foundation with 3 years of hands-on field experience.
About.paragraph3: I master modern software technologies, databases, and foundational DevOps practices under Linux and Windows. I love the challenge of designing fast, reliable, structured, and secure applications from the ground up.

sie2.description: Contributed to the development of the second-generation Environmental Information System (SIE2).
responsibilities: Architecting and developing responsive Front-Office and Back-Office web interfaces leveraging Angular 21.
End-to-end UX/UI specification and wireframing for the web application.
Integrating RESTful APIs and securing authentication using JWT and Http-Only cookies.
Designing and implementing a Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) framework for user management.
Engineered a dynamic, user-configurable dashboard to enhance user experience.

rccm.description: Contributed to project management assistance as part of the modernization project for the Trade and Personal Property Credit Register (RCCM) in Cameroon.
responsibilities: Automated historical data migration into RCCM-OHADA software leveraging RPA / automated scripts.
Led and supervised a data entry team, ensuring strict data quality control and cleansing of legacy records.
Troubleshot and optimized automated workflows, successfully reducing process downtime by 20%.

Drove functional and QA testing for the SINSAH platform, successfully cutting production bugs by 30%.
Facilitated train-the-trainer workshops to ensure seamless onboarding and user adoption of the SINSAH platform.

gbc.description: Developed a mobile banking collection application for microfinance institutions: Gold Bank Collection.
responsibilities: Engineered and maintained the native mobile application using Android Studio (Java) and optimized local storage with SQLite.
Executed testing and debugging cycles, leading to a 20% efficiency increase in core banking operations and transactions.
